writeup: TIC 188404859 is a candidate eclipsing binary star identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry. The system shows a primary eclipse causing a 5.34 percent dimming with an orbital period of 0.8189 days, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 212.2 using the Box Least Squares algorithm. Pixel-level image analysis provides supporting evidence, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 6.0, though the centroid offset of 1.1 arcsec warrants consideration. No secondary eclipse was detected in the data. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unrecognized target. While the machine-learning screening score of 0.34 indicates moderate confidence in the pipeline's assessment, the candidate passed all automated data quality checks without flag concerns.
